note: Copied word for word from the Google reviews shown on the old toptinroofing.com homepage (Trustindex widget), all 5 stars, checked 2026-10-19. Owner to supply the Google Business Profile link (url) and confirm reviewers are happy to appear.

reviews.author: Nicholas Delany
reviews.text: Couldn’t fault them if I tried. Ethan was amazing to work with. Efficient and competitive quote process leading to a very seamless delivery.

reviews.author: Pheonix Su'a
reviews.text: Top Tin Roofing turned my leaky disaster into a rooftop masterpiece. The crew were on time, on budget, and even made roofing look cool. My only regret is not doing it sooner—highly recommend and give them 5 big booms!

reviews.author: Elijah Hayward
reviews.text: the photo speaks for itself. Bunch of good blokes, respectful and hard workers. Definitely coming back to these guys for more work!

reviews.author: Zvarn Perenara
reviews.text: Couldn’t be happier with Toptin Roofing! The crew was super friendly, turned up on time, and got the job done with zero fuss. The roof looks awesome and you can tell the quality is top notch. They kept me in the loop the whole way and even cleaned everything up when they were done. Would 100% recommend them to anyone needing roofing work

reviews.author: Kees Hapeta
reviews.text: I couldn’t be happier with the work from Toptin Roofing! From the very first phone call, the team was professional, friendly, and genuinely cared about making sure the job was done right. They arrived on time, worked efficiently, and kept the site clean and tidy throughout. The attention to detail and quality of workmanship is outstanding.My roof looks fantastic and I feel confident it’s built to last. Communication was excellent, with updates every step of the way, and the final cost matched the initial quote exactly. If you want a reliable, honest, and skilled roofing company, I can’t recommend Toptin Roofing highly enough.

reviews.author: Holly Clark
reviews.text: the guys at Top Tin roofing killed it, honestly couldn’t recommend more. the communication, professionalism and expertise were like no other 🙌🏼🙌🏼

reviews.author: Hana Delahunty
reviews.text: Top Tin Roofing is handsdown the most impressive team I’ve ever had work on my home!From the moment they arrived, their professionalism, energy, and teamwork were next level. Every single person on the crew knew exactly what they were doing, working together like a well oiled machine to get my roof installed perfectly. They weren’t just skilled they were friendly, respectful, and genuinely cared about the quality of their work. You could tell they took pride in every nail, every sheet, and every detail, making sure everything was done to the highest standard. Watching them work was like watching roofing artists in action. They finished the job on time, left my property spotless, and the end result is a roof that looks absolutely stunning. This isn’t just a company it’s a dream team, and I can’t recommend them highly enough!

reviews.author: Lilia Carter
reviews.text: Had this crew come out to my place, was very impressed with how quickly they got the job done considering our home is quite big. The boys where great with last minute requests and would recommend highly.

reviews.author: Natasha Condon
reviews.text: The team came through on a repair to fix water ingress through the roof.  Professional communication , efficient and kept to their schedule.

reviews.author: Finance
reviews.text: The boys done the job on short notice and did a great job. Was happy to give the crew a case at the end of the job. Cheers boys 🍻
